summary: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 11, 2026, reporting two amendments: Amendment No. 2 to the Asset Purchase Agreement, modifying payment terms of a previously closed $16 million acquisition of SeaTrepid assets completed March 2025, and a Second Amendment to its Term Loan Agreement. No new deal terms are disclosed; no price, premium, or board recommendation. This is a routine contractual update, not a new special-situation event. The filing is a standard 8-K entry into material definitive agreements post-transaction, not itself a special situation.
